entries.subject: Radius adopted from the published record
entries.finding: Radius: Limb-darkened angular diameter 20.922 ± 0.036 mas (quadratic limb-darkening fit) measured with IOTA/IONIC by Lacour et al. (2008), A&A 485, 561; at the Hipparcos distance this is the record’s radius. Adopted 17,617,284 km, 25.3231 solar radii at 695700 km per solar radius. No gravitational parameter is adopted. presentationUp: the display axis (celestial north at the star) is up; no spin axis is adopted. Placement: SIMBAD basic record for * alf Boo (HIP 69673), ICRS J2000 position, reference 2007A&A...474..653V, retrieved 2026-09-21: https://simbad.cds.unistra.fr/simbad/sim-id?Ident=alf+Boo; Inverse of the Hipparcos new-reduction parallax 88.83 ± 0.54 mas (van Leeuwen 2007) via SIMBAD.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the power law I(mu) = mu^0.258 that Lacour et al. (2008), A&A 485, 561 fit to the star's resolved disc (IOTA/IONIC H band, 1.5-1.8 um, seven channels fitted with one law; not a visible band).
